content:
lea: New RC ready for origination: rc-2026-03-24-1 -> gcr.io/redwood/inf:rc-night-1. Uploaded artifact and kicked off quick staging smoke. Planning to promote in the 02:00 UTC change window (night shift). docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/rc-night-1

jordan: nice. drop the image sha and the infra pin so infra can lock it down. also, any migration?

lea: sha256:ab12c7d4, infra pin: infra:v12.3 (pinned). No DB schema migration. small feature-flag rollout only: NEW_TOKENIZER=false until full promote.

sam: checklist? canary route, kv-preheat, feature flags, observability smoke?

lea: checklist: 1) manifests updated, 2) kv-preheat job ran (job 99102, success), 3) canary route staged at 1%, 4) dashboards templated, 5) perf-eval run.

jordan: ops-sheriff are you on for the 02:00 window? pinging @ops-sheriff

ops-sheriff: oncall for that window. fallback is sam. runbook reference: /runbooks/rc-night-promo. paging configured to #incidents and phone.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Promotion request queued by lea. Prechecks: CI=pass, SCA=pass, kv-preheat=ok, perf-eval=pass. Canary scheduled for 02:00:00 UTC. Ramp plan: 1% -> 10% over 8m -> 40% over 12m -> 100% if metrics clear. Auto-abort gates: 5xx > 1% OR p99 > +300ms OR downstream embedding error >1.5%.

lea: quick staging logs:
```
2026-03-24T00:05:12Z INFO staging start
2026-03-24T00:05:18Z INFO kv preheat completed
2026-03-24T00:05:25Z INFO healthcheck ok
```

jordan: we should add cost-sanity: token rate per-request > +25% for 15m should trigger pause and investigation (could be a regression).

sam: agree. add that to rollback triggers. Also, if any of the downstream vectorstore calls start timing out >500ms (trend) -> abort.

ops-sheriff: noted and added to runbook. Also enabling deploy-bot deadman auto-fallback after 6m at any ramp step if gates fail.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary started at 02:00:02 UTC. Instance set: rc-night-canary (2 pods). Traffic: 1%

lea: health at 1% looks clean. no 5xx, p95/p99 within baseline.

sam: running E2E smoke. sample size 20 -> pass 19/20 (one transient latency).

jordan: if staging E2E flakiness persists at 10% we should keep hold and triage. ops-sheriff?

ops-sheriff: agreed. manual hold at 10% for 7m to eyeball traces. I'm available.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] increasing to 10% at 02:08 UTC per plan.

lea: metrics after 8m at 10%: 5xx=0.12%, p99 +90ms, token-cost +8%. downstream embeddings err=0.6%. all good.

sam: quality checks good. spot-check prompts look identical baseline.

jordan: ramp to 40% then? ops-sheriff give manual ack.

ops-sheriff: manual ack for ramp to 40%. watch E2E over next 12m.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] ramping to 40% at 02:20 UTC.

lea: at 40% after 10m: 5xx=0.4% (still below abort threshold), p99 +150ms, token-cost +12%. there is a small spike in embedding timeouts localized to a downstream cluster (team notified).

sam: embedding errors increased to 1.4% momentarily. ops team says they are investigating but not systemic. recommend hold for another 5m.

jordan: hold and don't proceed to 100% yet. we should be conservative. also prepare rollback command in case we need it: `kubectl set image deploy/llm-service llm=gcr.io/redwood/inf:rc-prev && kubectl patch cm release-pin -p '{"data":{"current":"rc-prev"}}'`.

ops-sheriff: placing manual hold at 40%. invoking tracing zoom if embedding team doesn't have a quick fix.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] hold acknowledged at 02:35 UTC. Canary traffic at 40%. Auto-abort still armed.

lea: embedding team found a mis-routed IP table rule causing occasional latency spikes. fix pushed to their staging, rolling forward. monitoring for recovery.

sam: after fix, embedding errors back to 0.3%. p99 back to +80ms. Good to continue.

jordan: proceed to 100% but keep NEW_TOKENIZER=false until final validation. ops-sheriff, any compliance holds?

ops-sheriff: compliance clear. KMS rotations checked. proceed when deploy-bot is ready.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] ramping to 100% at 02:48:10 UTC. Pre-promotion check: gates green.

lea: executing final promote and pin update now. command: `kubectl set image deploy/llm-service llm=gcr.io/redwood/inf:rc-night-1 && kubectl patch cm release-pin -p '{"data":{"current":"rc-night-1"}}'`

jordan: changelog updated and release note posted to /CHANGELOG. tagging release owners.

ops-sheriff: monitoring for 30m post-promo. oncall rota active. paging ready.

sam: quick perf sample at +10m: p99 +85ms, 5xx 0.08%, token-cost +10% — within expected.

lea: RC promoted, release pinned, docs updated. posting follow-up in 24h with perf deltas and any lessons. thanks team :rocket:

jordan: nice execution. closing thread. metadata: promoted-by=lea, sheriff=ops-sheriff, tag=rc-night-1.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] promotion complete at 02:49:01 UTC. Live image: gcr.io/redwood/inf:rc-night-1.
